section: Microsoft Teams Rooms Express Install: benefits of modern deployment models
body:
AVI-SPL's Microsoft Teams Rooms FAQ for IT leaders answers what a modern deployment model, such as Microsoft Teams Rooms Express Install, offers at the deployment stage.

**What to know**
- Such approaches can cut installation time and keep room downtime to a minimum.
- They can lower the costs tied to upgrading rooms and deploying new ones.
- Meeting room modernization programs can be scaled faster, with consistency kept across the environment.
- Faster deployment can also bring time-to-value forward.
- AVI-SPL sells Microsoft Teams Rooms Express Install bundles that are ready to buy, and also custom solutions.

**When to use this**
Use when a customer asks why to choose an Express Install style deployment over a traditional one, or whether AVI-SPL sells ready-made Teams Rooms bundles.

**Not stated in this source**
The answer gives no installation times, prices or bundle contents.
